frozen_obligations.population: EXP29-C01, EXP29-V01 and EXP29-V02, all STEP0030_CALIBRATION
frozen_obligations.estimand: paired IA_INTERNET_BATEIA minus IA_INTERNET under identical case, model, effort, output contract and native-web budget
frozen_obligations.completion: exactly three pair records and six committed session starts after one global PASS preflight; global counter 16 to 22 of 108
frozen_obligations.dispatch: both arms of every pair are attempted exactly once in the frozen order, even if the first arm is invalid; single global in-flight, at least 120 seconds between starts, timeout 900 seconds, no behavioral retry
frozen_obligations.control: one to three native web calls and zero MCP calls
frozen_obligations.treatment: exactly one completed bateia_recommend before the first of one to three native web calls, with no other MCP tool
frozen_obligations.output: one schema-valid CompactEngineeringInvestigation JSON, byte-identical to the last assistant message and at most 65536 raw UTF-8 bytes
frozen_obligations.editorial_target: 18000 Unicode characters; an excess is recorded only as concision debt and never creates structural invalidity
frozen_obligations.decoder: scan raw JSONL tokens without map-last-wins; classify unsupported event encodings OPAQUE and preserve Unknown
frozen_obligations.evaluation: freeze blind output-quality receipts before revealing arms, events, invocation, order, tool volume or cost; audit catalysis only after reveal
frozen_obligations.inconclusive: neutral evidence, never an automatic success or defeat
frozen_obligations.causal_credit: requires an observable Bateia direction followed by later native web evidence with a locator and a useful confirmed, rejected or narrowed finding; volume or cost alone cannot win

unknown_policy: Unknown is an explicit abstention for unavailable or undecodable facts. It cannot be imputed as pass, fail, causal credit or equality.
winner_policy: No expected winner is selected. A treatment advantage requires blind quality advantage plus useful trace-supported catalysis; otherwise report no supported advantage or insufficient evidence.
